    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters tournament coverage begins early each day with featured group streaming around 9:15-10:15 a.m. ET on Masters.com and Paramount+, with main TV coverage starting at 1 p.m. or 3 p.m. ET on ESPN (Thursday/Friday) and CBS (Saturday/Sunday). 
    Key Coverage Times (EDT): 
    • Thursday-Friday (Rounds 1 & 2):
      • Featured Groups/Streams: ~9:15 a.m. – 7:30 p.m. (Masters.com, Paramount+)
      • Early Coverage: 1 p.m. – 3 p.m. (Prime Video)
      • Main Coverage: 3 p.m. – 7:30 p.m. (ESPN)
    • Saturday-Sunday (Rounds 3 & 4):
      • Featured Groups: Starts around 10:15 a.m.
      • Main Coverage: 2 p.m. – 7 p.m. (CBS) 
    Key Streaming Options: 
    • Masters.com & App: Provides the most comprehensive, free, early-morning coverage (Amen Corner, Featured Groups) starting around 8:45-9:30 a.m.
    • Paramount+: Streams CBS coverage and "Masters on the Range".
    • Prime Video: Covers early action on Thursday and Friday.
